en: Psalms 139
For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.

p.src: 1  LORD, you have searched me, and you know me.

en: LORD, you have searched me, and you know me.
u.src: 1  LORD, you have searched me, and you know me.

p.src: 2  You know my sitting down and my rising up. You perceive my thoughts from afar.

en: You know my sitting down and my rising up. You perceive my thoughts from afar.
u.src: 2  You know my sitting down and my rising up. You perceive my thoughts from afar.

p.src: 3  You search out my path and my lying down, and are acquainted with all my ways.

en: You search out my path and my lying down, and are acquainted with all my ways.
u.src: 3  You search out my path and my lying down, and are acquainted with all my ways.

p.src: 4  For there is not a word on my tongue, but behold, LORD, you know it altogether.

en: For there is not a word on my tongue, but behold, LORD, you know it altogether.
u.src: 4  For there is not a word on my tongue, but behold, LORD, you know it altogether.

p.src: 5  You hem me in behind and before. You laid your hand on me.

en: You hem me in behind and before. You laid your hand on me.
u.src: 5  You hem me in behind and before. You laid your hand on me.

p.src: 6  This knowledge is beyond me. It’s lofty. I can’t attain it.

en: This knowledge is beyond me. It’s lofty. I can’t attain it.
u.src: 6  This knowledge is beyond me. It’s lofty. I can’t attain it.

p.src: 7  Where could I go from your Spirit? Or where could I flee from your presence?

en: Where could I go from your Spirit? Or where could I flee from your presence?
u.src: 7  Where could I go from your Spirit? Or where could I flee from your presence?

p.src: 8  If I ascend up into heaven, you are there. If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, you are there!

en: If I ascend up into heaven, you are there. If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, you are there!
u.src: 8  If I ascend up into heaven, you are there. If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, you are there!

en: 139:8 Sheol is the place of the dead.

p.src: 9  If I take the wings of the dawn, and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea,

en: If I take the wings of the dawn, and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea,
u.src: 9  If I take the wings of the dawn, and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea,

p.src: 10  even there your hand will lead me, and your right hand will hold me.

en: even there your hand will lead me, and your right hand will hold me.
u.src: 10  even there your hand will lead me, and your right hand will hold me.

p.src: 11  If I say, “Surely the darkness will overwhelm me. The light around me will be night,”

en: If I say, “Surely the darkness will overwhelm me. The light around me will be night,”
u.src: 11  If I say, “Surely the darkness will overwhelm me. The light around me will be night,”

p.src: 12  even the darkness doesn’t hide from you, but the night shines as the day. The darkness is like light to you.

en: even the darkness doesn’t hide from you, but the night shines as the day. The darkness is like light to you.
u.src: 12  even the darkness doesn’t hide from you, but the night shines as the day. The darkness is like light to you.

p.src: 13  For you formed my inmost being. You knit me together in my mother’s womb.

en: For you formed my inmost being. You knit me together in my mother’s womb.
u.src: 13  For you formed my inmost being. You knit me together in my mother’s womb.

p.src: 14  I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.

en: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.
u.src: 14  I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.

p.src: 15  My frame wasn’t hidden from you, when I was made in secret, woven together in the depths of the earth.

en: My frame wasn’t hidden from you, when I was made in secret, woven together in the depths of the earth.
u.src: 15  My frame wasn’t hidden from you, when I was made in secret, woven together in the depths of the earth.

p.src: 16  Your eyes saw my body. In your book they were all written, the days that were ordained for me, when as yet there were none of them.

en: Your eyes saw my body. In your book they were all written, the days that were ordained for me, when as yet there were none of them.
u.src: 16  Your eyes saw my body. In your book they were all written, the days that were ordained for me, when as yet there were none of them.

zh: 139:16 或譯：我被造的肢體尚未有其一

p.src: 17  How precious to me are your thoughts, God! How vast is their sum!

en: How precious to me are your thoughts, God! How vast is their sum!
u.src: 17  How precious to me are your thoughts, God! How vast is their sum!

p.src: 18  If I would count them, they are more in number than the sand. When I wake up, I am still with you.

en: If I would count them, they are more in number than the sand. When I wake up, I am still with you.
u.src: 18  If I would count them, they are more in number than the sand. When I wake up, I am still with you.

p.src: 19  If only you, God, would kill the wicked. Get away from me, you bloodthirsty men!

en: If only you, God, would kill the wicked. Get away from me, you bloodthirsty men!
u.src: 19  If only you, God, would kill the wicked. Get away from me, you bloodthirsty men!

p.src: 20  For they speak against you wickedly. Your enemies take your name in vain.

en: For they speak against you wickedly. Your enemies take your name in vain.
u.src: 20  For they speak against you wickedly. Your enemies take your name in vain.

p.src: 21  LORD, don’t I hate those who hate you? Am I not grieved with those who rise up against you?

en: LORD, don’t I hate those who hate you? Am I not grieved with those who rise up against you?
u.src: 21  LORD, don’t I hate those who hate you? Am I not grieved with those who rise up against you?

p.src: 22  I hate them with perfect hatred. They have become my enemies.

en: I hate them with perfect hatred. They have become my enemies.
u.src: 22  I hate them with perfect hatred. They have become my enemies.

p.src: 23  Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts.

en: Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts.
u.src: 23  Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts.

p.src: 24  See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.

en: See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.
u.src: 24  See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.
